drafted_by: assistant (Claude), 2026-10-13; to be reviewed by the project owner before annotation
basis: NASA HFACS levels (unsafe acts, preconditions, supervision, organisational influences), as used in the NOAA-N Prime and Starliner reports
technical failure classes used across the corpus' board reports (design, manufacturing, software, test/verification, operations)

roles.root: stated by the board as a root/primary/proximate cause
roles.contributing: stated as a contributing/intermediate/significant cause or factor
roles.observation: deficiency noted by the board but not stated to have caused the mishap

children.name: Hardware design deficiency
children.desc: design (geometry, materials, margins, redundancy) inadequate for the conditions; e.g. joint design, insulation, fairing separation design

children.name: Software / requirements / specification error
children.desc: flight or ground software fault, wrong requirement, unhandled exception, specification error

children.name: Manufacturing / workmanship / material defect
children.desc: defect introduced in production, assembly, handling or supplier processes

children.name: Interface / integration / heritage-reuse mismatch
children.desc: units mismatch, incompatible interfaces, component reused outside its qualified envelope

children.name: Environmental condition beyond design
children.desc: temperature, debris/foam strike, loads, radiation, atmosphere, thermal environment exceeding what the design tolerated

children.name: Component failure (unexplained / wear / random)
children.desc: part failed without a design or workmanship cause identified (e.g. thruster, valve, battery, gyro)

children.name: Inadequate testing / qualification
children.desc: tests missing, not representative, not end-to-end, qualification by similarity

children.name: Inadequate analysis / modelling / simulation
children.desc: models, simulations or analyses wrong, missing or not validated

children.name: Inadequate review / independent assessment
children.desc: design/peer/readiness reviews missed the problem; lack of independent verification

children.name: Procedure deficient or not followed
children.desc: operational/test procedure missing, wrong, or violated

children.name: Operational configuration / parameter / data error
children.desc: wrong command, parameter, uploaded data or configuration state

children.name: Inadequate anomaly response / contingency planning
children.desc: anomaly not recognised or handled; contingency plans missing or not executed

children.name: Inadequate monitoring / telemetry / data use
children.desc: available data not monitored, telemetry gaps, warnings missed

children.name: Decision or skill-based error
children.desc: an individual or team made a wrong decision or execution error

children.name: Training / qualification / experience of personnel
children.desc: personnel not trained, inexperienced, or unqualified for the task

children.name: Communication failure
children.desc: information not passed between people, teams, contractor and agency

children.name: Schedule / cost / launch pressure
children.desc: pressure to meet schedule or budget affected decisions

children.name: Risk acceptance / normalisation of deviance
children.desc: known anomalies accepted as normal; flawed risk assessment; flight rationale based on success

children.name: Safety & mission assurance deficiency
children.desc: safety/quality organisation weak, silent, not independent or absent

children.name: Systems engineering / configuration management deficiency
children.desc: requirements flow-down, configuration control, change management, systems integration process

children.name: Oversight / organisational structure / roles
children.desc: unclear responsibilities, inadequate contractor/government oversight or insight, matrix management issues

children.name: Staffing / resources
children.desc: teams understaffed or spread thin, insufficient resources
